title.value: Untangling tradeoffs between recurrence and self-attention in neural networks
title.justification: The title was clearly mentioned at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: Untangling tradeoffs between recurrence and self-attention in neural networks

analysis.description: The paper presents a formal analysis of self-attention mechanisms in recurrent networks, particularly focusing on how self-attention aids in mitigating vanishing gradients and improves the capturing of long-term dependencies. A relevancy screening mechanism is proposed to enable scalable usage of sparse self-attention with recursion while maintaining effective gradient propagation.

type.justification: The paper focuses on a formal analysis, proving the impact of self-attention on gradient propagation in recurrent networks, and extends theoretical guarantees for memory usage and gradient propagation.
type.quote: In this work, we present a formal analysis of how self-attention affects gradient propagation in recurrent networks, and prove that it mitigates the problem of vanishing gradients when trying to capture long-term dependencies by establishing concrete bounds for gradient norms.

name.justification: The paper is centered on analyzing neural network architectures, particularly recurrent neural networks and self-attention mechanisms within them.
name.quote: Historically, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have been the deep network architecture of choice for this type of task since, just like neural circuits in the brain, they enable dynamics that can be shaped to interact with input streams.

name.justification: Self-attention is a significant focus of the paper as it presents a formal analysis of how self-attention aids in gradient propagation and mitigates vanishing gradient issues.
name.quote: Attention and self-attention mechanisms, are now central to state-of-the-art deep learning on sequential tasks.

name.justification: RNNs are analyzed in the paper for performance on sequential tasks and how augmenting them with self-attention influences their operation.
